main_body: Wooden cart bed (rows ~10-21) carrying three grey pots of flowers, with two wheels or legs below
top_band: none clear: a 1-2 row brown rim at rows ~10-11 and a dark shadow row ~13 behind the pots; no lighter horizontal surface of several rows
evidence: Down the middle column the pot tops are hidden by flowers. Under them is a thin dark-brown rim, then a dark band, then a flat mid-brown front face (rows ~14-20) with only faint grain. No cart bed floor or top surface is visible, and no front-edge highlight separates a top from the face. The bed reads as a front-view plank with pots standing behind it. The short side stub and handle at right are a small detail and give no credit. This is front elevation or rim only.

style.evidence: The flowers and foliage are varied, with several greens, reds and yellows, and the outlines are tinted dark brown. The large wooden bed is a mostly flat mid-brown with little grain or per-plank highlights. The grey pots have only about 3 tones. The wheels or legs are simple. Overall it is thinner than the roofed well and the stall, which have 5-6 steps per material, so it is not at the reference level.
